"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will press China to restrain North Korea.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump's approach to North Korea is incoherent and rather than solving a global crisis, would create a new one.",
